answer: Persistent work-history weighting. Each agent's influence is the discounted sum of verified past jobs, so a fresh clone starts at zero and must wander through the same slow accumulation the honest agent already paid. Rewards route through a shared inlet that only pays accounts with provable task lineage. Sybils must fund real work per clone and wait out the decay window; forgery of yarrow-tagged records is checked against counter-signed logs, making each fake identity cost more than simply acting honestly.
